summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.13/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.13 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 2, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 29¢ lower than a week ago, 4¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.47 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.89) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.48).
